agent.chair.desc: src/committee_chair.py: computes agreement (threshold 85): candidate for review, or abstain with one reason code.

agent.specialist.desc: Decides: approve, ask for an edit, or reject. No automatic approval.
agent.verifier.desc: A different model family re-classifies without seeing the classifier's tags.

learn.how: How the specialist teaches the agents
learn.how.1: On edit or reject, choose “What was wrong?” and “Correct method”: a rejection becomes a lesson.
learn.how.2: Switch on “Teach the agents with this” for clear cases, right and wrong; five per method per tafsir is a good start.
learn.how.3: Check each mufassir's golden rules below; any correction reaches every agent.
learn.how.4: After each review session the sample is re-run with the profile, and the counts are compared with the previous run.
learn.subtitle: How the specialist's decisions become examples the agents learn from, and what the mufassir profile changes.
learn.teach_note: Saved as a reference only (window, spans, labels); it enters the profile packets in the next run and approves nothing.
learn.title: Agent learning
learn.traps_note: A trap: a method resting only on a marker the profile knows is false (the target verse as heading, chain words without a Prophetic text, «قلت» inside a report), measured the same way in both arms.
